title: Treat an untracked husky runner folder like a tracked hooks folder
context: The frozen spec says paqad does not write to a tracked hooks folder and names the husky files only for that case. Review reproduced a false green on default husky 9, where .husky/_ is git-ignored: paqad appended lines to the runner folder, they never run, and doctor stayed green. The owner decided to fix this in this PR.
